note: Decision evals: a model gets the skill text (with) or a one-line description of the gateway (without), the scenario, and an LLM judge grades each assertion; 3 samples per condition, single-shot completions without tools. Run 2026-11-26: with the skill 38/38 assertions passed; without it 24/42. The baseline already suggests parallel work when asked directly (S1 batch_parallel passed without the skill), yet the real agent ran 38 images one at a time, so the skill's value is making batch, names, background runs and unchanged reference files the explicit default. S5 had only one graded sample with the skill (two judge calls failed). Trigger queries: 15/15 with an LLM classifier choosing among this skill, flow2api-gateway-ops and four unrelated skills. Not run: real agents with tools.
